87:14.210: Dar Al-Salam Center (resource 210) repeats the meaning of 87:13 ('Sonra onun içinde ne ölür, ne de yaşar') at 87:14, whose Arabic is قَدْ أَفْلَحَ مَن تَزَكَّىٰ. The same text is returned by the live quran.com API, so the defect is upstream. The true 87:14 text of that translation could not be sourced and is not invented. Verified 2026-10-17.
